decisions.key: guide/Authentication/Migration from idp.bexio.com to auth.bexio.com/Are there breaking changes?
decisions.reason: The connector uses the new issuer and Saloon form-body token requests, not query parameters. It does not decode sub/locale/shard_id claims or assume an email subject. The README persists the refreshed access token, refresh token and expiry; consent and token rotation remain consuming-application responsibilities. Re-reviewed after final documentation and owned-project fixture changes; the contract disposition is unchanged. Documentation-only re-review: contacts redirect restored and license declaration linked to composer.json. API code and validation unchanged.
